title: DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. translated_title: DexWAC：面向灵巧机器人操作的统一世界-演员-评论家模型
translated_abstract: 机器人演示所提供的信息远不止可供模仿的动作：它们揭示了动作如何改变世界，以及这些变化如何促成任务成功。近期的世界-动作模型通过联合预测动作与未来观测，为视觉-语言-动作模型引入了第一种信号，但这种预测能力仅作为策略学习的辅助损失。与此同时，大多数策略改进方法在相互分离的模型中学习动力学与价值，这增加了训练开销，并限制了这些互补目标之间的表征共享。我们提出DexWAC，一个统一的世界-演员-评论家模型，它在单一的机器人预训练阶段中联合学习演员、动作条件世界模型和自举评论家。我们的关键洞察是：视觉预测鼓励与控制相关的特征，而价值监督促进与任务相关的表征；二者结合共同塑造出一种适合……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DexWAC，在单一预训练阶段统一学习演员、动作条件世界模型和自举评论家，利用视觉预测与价值监督的互补作用塑造兼具控制相关性与任务相关性的表征，从而提升灵巧机器人操作能力。
en_tdlr: DexWAC unifies an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single pretraining stage for dexterous robot manipulation, leveraging the complementary effects of visual prediction and value supervision to shape representations that are both control-relevant and task-relevant.
